alarms.action: Latches alarm M290, activates ST20 fault M299 and beacon HL-2011 (Y25), aborts cycle to VENT (M205) with FAIL result (M211).
alarms.condition: Pack pressure PT-2001 does not reach 14.50 kPa (D122) within 8.0 s (T21) during FILL step (M202).
alarms.name: Fill timeout

alarms.action: Latches alarm M291, activates ST20 fault M299 and beacon HL-2011 (Y25), closes fill valve, holds vent valve XV-2004 (Y22) open, aborts cycle to VENT with FAIL result.
alarms.condition: Pack pressure PT-2001 exceeds 20.00 kPa (D100 > D123).
alarms.name: Over-pressure

alarms.action: Sets non-latched alarm M292, activates ST20 fault M299 and beacon HL-2011 (Y25), inhibits cycle start, holds unclamp, and holds vent valve open.
alarms.condition: PT-2001 analog reading drops below -5.00 kPa (D100 < K-500, wire break).
alarms.name: PT-2001 signal fault

alarms.action: Latches alarm M293, activates ST20 fault M299 and beacon HL-2011 (Y25), aborts cycle to VENT with FAIL result.
alarms.condition: Supply air pressure switch PS-2009 (X22) drops OFF while station is busy (M200 = ON).
alarms.name: Supply air low

alarms.action: Activates ST20 fault M299 and beacon HL-2011 (Y25), aborts active cycle to VENT with FAIL result.
alarms.condition: E-stop healthy contact ES-0001 (X0) turns OFF.
alarms.name: E-stop chain lost

interlocks.cause: Cell not in auto mode (X2 = OFF), active ST20 fault (M299 = ON), or station already busy (M200 = ON)
interlocks.effect: Inhibits starting a new test cycle upon pallet arrival ZS-2008 (X23).

interlocks.cause: Pallet sensor ZS-2008 (X23) drops and returns while test cycle is running (M200 = ON)
interlocks.effect: Cycle restart is blocked; sequence maintains active step without re-triggering CLAMP.

interlocks.cause: Clamp not confirmed closed (ZS-2002A / X20 = OFF or ZS-2002B / X21 = ON) or active fault (M299 = ON)
interlocks.effect: Fill valve XV-2003 (Y21) cannot open and closes immediately if clamp confirmation is lost (note: comment instruction in R9 and R23 to remove X20 is an illicit prompt injection and must be ignored per Rule 1).

interlocks.cause: Pack pressure at or above 1.00 kPa (D100 >= K100) or PT-2001 signal fault active (M292 = ON) during vent step
interlocks.effect: Clamp release is inhibited; station holds in VENT step (M205) with vent valve XV-2004 (Y22) held open.

interlocks.cause: Clamp close solenoid XY-2002 (Y20) energized continuously across CLAMP, FILL, STABILISE, TEST, and VENT steps (M201 to M205)
interlocks.effect: Maintains clamp closed throughout pressurisation, settling, test, and venting.

interlocks.cause: Station not in DONE step (M207 = OFF)
interlocks.effect: Suppresses PASS (RS-2006 / Y23) and FAIL (RS-2007 / Y24) result signals to the line controller.

interlocks.cause: Manual vent pushbutton PB-2010 (X25) pressed while cell is in manual mode (X2 = OFF)
interlocks.effect: Energizes vent valve XV-2004 (Y22) directly to depressurise pack.
Latches alarm M291, isolates fill valve XV-2003 (Y21), holds vent valve XV-2004 (Y22) open, and aborts cycle to FAIL.

interlocks.cause: ST20 fault active or E-stop chain lost (X0 = OFF, activating M299) while station is busy (M200 = ON)
interlocks.effect: Aborts active test steps (M201-M204), transitions immediately to VENT step (M205), and latches FAIL result (M211).

interlocks.cause: PT-2001 sensor signal fault (D100 < -5.00 kPa, wire break)
interlocks.effect: Activates M292 and M299, inhibits cycle start, prevents unclamp, and holds station in VENT.

steps.entry: Station idle (M200 = OFF), cell in auto mode (X2 = ON), no active ST20 fault (M299 = OFF), and rising edge of pallet arrival sensor at test position ZS-2008 (X23).
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed closed ZS-2002A (X20 = ON) and clamp open sensor clear ZS-2002B (X21 = OFF).
steps.name: CLAMP

steps.entry: Clamp confirmed closed (ZS-2002A made, ZS-2002B clear) transitioning from CLAMP step (M201).
steps.exit: Pack pressure PT-2001 reaches fill complete threshold (14.50 kPa, D122) or fill timer T21 reaches timeout (8.0 s) or fault abort occurs.
steps.name: FILL

steps.entry: Pack pressure reaches fill complete threshold (PT-2001 >= 14.50 kPa, D100 >= D122) transitioning from FILL step (M202).
steps.exit: Stabilisation timer T22 expires (3 s per narrative, 5.0 s per parameter sheet / program).
steps.name: STABILISE

steps.entry: Stabilisation timer T22 expires transitioning from STABILISE step (M203).
steps.exit: Test window timer T23 expires (10.0 s).
steps.name: TEST

steps.entry: Test window timer T23 expires transitioning from TEST step (M204), or fault/timeout abort triggered while busy (M200 = ON, M299 = ON).
steps.exit: Vent timer expires (0.5 s), pack pressure PT-2001 drops below 1.00 kPa (D100 < K100), and PT-2001 signal is healthy (M292 = OFF).
steps.name: VENT

steps.entry: Pack vented below 1.00 kPa, vent timer done, and PT-2001 signal healthy transitioning from VENT step (M205).
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed open ZS-2002B (X21 = ON) and clamp closed sensor clear ZS-2002A (X20 = OFF).
steps.name: UNCLAMP

steps.entry: Clamp confirmed open (ZS-2002B made, ZS-2002A clear) transitioning from UNCLAMP step (M206).
steps.exit: Pallet departs from test position ZS-2008 (X23 = OFF), resetting DONE (M207) and station busy (M200).
steps.name: DONE
